opportunities.title: Bitcoin Firms Want AI Labs to Find Their Bugs. Read That Again.
opportunities.why_now: Crypto companies are publicly asking AI labs for early developer access to harden Bitcoin, while a separate red team is already using Chinese AI (Kimi) to hunt flaws in the protocol — the outsourcing-your-security-to-a-black-box trend is now mainstream.
opportunities.angle: Security-led op-ed: outsourcing core protocol security review to opaque AI models (foreign or domestic) is a supply-chain risk, not a fix — trace the incentive mismatch and what 'early access' actually means for adversarial actors

opportunities.title: Trezor Just Taught 14,000 Hardware Wallet Buyers Why Shipping Metadata Is an Attack Surface
opportunities.why_now: A fulfilment partner breach exposed names/addresses of Trezor customers — the exact dataset attackers need for targeted physical and phishing attacks against known crypto holders.
opportunities.angle: Practical security explainer: what a shipping breach actually enables (SIM-swap targeting, mail theft, wrench attacks), plus a checklist for anyone who's ordered a hardware wallet in the last 2 years

opportunities.title: The $550K Google Ad That Looked Exactly Like Hyperliquid
opportunities.why_now: A single malicious Google ad drained over half a million dollars from a Hyperliquid user this week — a textbook, still-unsolved attack vector hitting sophisticated traders, not newbies.
opportunities.angle: Forensic breakdown format: how the ad spoofing worked, why platform-level trust signals failed, and the standing defense (bookmark your URLs, never click sponsored crypto links) that nobody follows

opportunities.title: Harmony's Rollback Dilemma Is the Same Old Story: 'Immutable' Chains Aren't
opportunities.why_now: Harmony is weighing a rollback after a suspected exploit inflated ONE supply — reviving the exact governance-vs-immutability fight the industry claimed it settled after The DAO.
opportunities.angle: Contrarian analysis: why rollbacks keep coming back on the table, what it says about L1 security assumptions investors should have priced in already, tie to past incidents (Harmony's own 2022 bridge hack)

opportunities.title: Tether's 'Clean' KPMG Audit Comes With No Actual Statements to Read
opportunities.why_now: Tether is loudly claiming its first full Big Four audit while simultaneously not publishing the underlying financials — a gap security-minded readers should immediately flag.
opportunities.angle: Skeptic's breakdown: what 'clean opinion' legally means vs. what transparency would require, why non-disclosure of statements undercuts the PR win, and what to actually watch for before trusting the $180B peg
